statisticalDefinition: sigma_stat=(sigma_minus+sigma_plus)/2; Q=sum((vobs-vmodel)^2/sigma^2). Asymmetric original errors remain in plots and data.
systematicDefinition: Sensitivity scenario sigma_i^2=sigma_stat^2+(fraction_Jiao*vobs)^2; not a measured full covariance. Additional correlated scenario C=D+outer(0.02*vobs,0.02*vobs), explicitly assumed coherent scale mode motivated by Jiao section2.1. Neither is asserted as unique covariance.
interpretation: Conditional residual diagnostics, not calibrated chi-square hypothesis tests, Bayes factors, sigma detections or formal evidence of a unique halo. No parameter fitted here; historical observational calibration and missing gas/CGM prevent claiming38 independent out-of-sample degrees of freedom.
baryonicSensitivity: Both models retain identical fixed baryons; neither halo nor baryons fitted freely. A baryon-only refit, gas or other density family would be a separate model and is not silently introduced.
